data.name: Bherulal
data.gender_notes: Bherulal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Bherulal is derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Brahma's Leap'. This name is associated with the Hindu god Brahma, who is the creator of the universe. According to mythology, Brahma took a leap to create the world. The name Bherulal represents courage, creation, and divine wisdom. The name Bherulal carries the meaning “Brahma's Leap” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bherulal usually hope their child will grow to embody brahma's leap and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Divine wisdom and courage from the creator of the universe.
data.etymology: Bherulal belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brahma's Leap.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bherulal total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
